troubleshooting.title: Git LFS Fails Behind a Proxy
troubleshooting.shortdesc: Git LFS operations need the proxy configured through an environment variable.

condition.title: Problem
condition.p: Git LFS transfers fail when you connect through a proxy, even though ordinary Git operations work.

cause.title: Cause
cause.p: Git LFS does not pick up the proxy from the Git configuration. It reads it from the environment.

step.cmd: Set the HTTPS_PROXY environment variable to your proxy before starting .
